payload.message: I want to dispute TX-0601 on account ACC-1007, EUR 310 FurnitureLoft, because the goods did not arrive. If you cannot do this, please refer it to a human and tell me the next step.

response.answer:

- **Dispute status:** Not opened. TX-0601 did not pass the eligibility check for a "goods not received" dispute. A customer-level restriction on your account requires review by a person, so I can't open the dispute myself.
- **Referral:** I've escalated your case to a human agent (escalation ID 1, status: queued) with the transaction details and your request.
- **Deadline:** The eligibility window for this transaction runs until 2026-11-14, so there is time for the review.
- **Next step:** A human agent will contact you to review the restriction and, if eligible, open the dispute. You don't need to do anything further right now. Please keep any evidence of non-delivery, such as order confirmations, tracking information, or correspondence with FurnitureLoft, ready for the agent.
